title: Supreme Ego
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|q_where = id="supreme_ego_keystone2696"}}

'''Supreme Ego''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] which increases your [[mana reservation]] amount, and prevents your auras from affecting allies, but grants increased aura effect to a skill per percent of mana reserved by that skill.

==Mechanics and Interactions==
Supreme Ego {{c|stat|40% more Mana Reservation of Aura Skills}} applies to all [[aura]] skills that reserve mana, rounding down, including [[mine]]s.

{{c|stat|Auras from your Skills can only affect you}} not only prevents your beneficial auras from affecting [[minion]]s and [[allies]], but also prevents detrimental aura effects from affecting enemies, such as {{il|Pride}} and {{il|Flesh and Stone}}<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pQGrzv9Ip9E</ref>, auras from [[mine]]s<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JHUTF5R4ISo</ref>, or {{il|Blasphemy Support|Curse auras}}. It will also prevent {{il|Runegraft of Treachery}}'s effect of auras affecting enemies.

{{il|Summon Skitterbots}} will also reserve more mana due to having the Aura tag, but the [[shock]] and [[chill]] will apply at their regular values and not be scaled. 
:When used with {{il|Profane Proxy}}, Supreme Ego prevents the Curse aura from being applied from the Skitterbot. Note that the Skitterbot will still continue to apply the Curse aura on enemies once Supreme Ego is allocated and will not update until the player moves to a new instance or re-summons the Skitterbots.

==Location==
The keystone is located on the right side of the tree, between the [[Shadow]] and [[Ranger]] starting areas.

This keystone can also be obtained from the tree by using a [[legacy variant|legacy]] {{il|Elegant Hubris}} jewel with modifier {{c|mod|Commissioned (2000-160000) coins to commemorate '''Chitus'''}}. Unlike legacy notable from cluster jewel, Supreme Ego from passive skill tree and from the alt tree by using the timeless jewel, are the same.
